**Unknown TEID gets an Error Indication**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | GTPv1-U / Tunnel Management Messages / Error Indication |
| Tags | negative |
| Verdict class | FAIL |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 15s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | main |
| Needs | GTP-U Echo |

## Clauses

- TS 29.281 7.3.1 (Rel-8 onward; Rel-8: V8.0.0 and V8.1.0 have a single sentence without the discard rule, added by V8.3.0; Rel-11: the 'all zeros' TEID exception is present by V11.6.0; Rel-12: current wording from V12.0.0, without "PDU Session"; Rel-15: "PDU Session" added in V15.4.0)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/GTPU-UNKNOWN-TEID-ERRIND.md).
